notes: Not approved and not published. The owner approves every post (npm run approve) after seeing the render and every caption.

Facts: Combo Coach opens on your Fight level (own Fight XP in full, Fit at half); YOUR LEVEL marks it; "Easy: Single strikes and short combos. Relaxed pace."; "Advanced: Singles to the hardest combos. Fight pace."; "The higher it is, the longer and harder the combos get"; a picked level is "for today only" (ComboCoachSetup, screenGuides cc-difficulty).

No number of punches on screen on purpose. The owner's rule is level 1 never gets more than 4 pieces, but the real level 1 pool tops out at 3 (the Level page prints "up to 3-strike combos"), and no combo in the whole pool is longer than 7. So never write "ten-punch combos" (nobody gets one), and say "short" for level 1.
The level 10 clip athlete must be a level 10 FIGHT athlete (Combo Coach reads the Fight side); the cc-lvl10 setup must show ADVANCED with YOUR LEVEL under it.
cc clips are 9 s and used about twice each: the hook, b1 and the gold beat re-use setup stretches (start 0.0, 1.2, 5.4). Retime to the real taps.
